chunks: (Fear) Allāh (and) keep Allāh in view in the matter of the Qur’ān.
No one should excel you in acting upon it.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali advise his sons regarding the Qur'an in his final will?
ai.summary: In this pivotal passage from his final testament, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs Hasan and Husayn to prioritize the Qur'an not merely as a text to be recited, but as the primary source of legal and spiritual guidance, urging them to lead by example in its practical application. This emphasis reflects the Shia scholarly view of the Qur'an as the enduring, infallible 'weightier' companion alongside the Ahl al-Bayt, ensuring that the Imams' authority is rooted in divine revelation. By commanding that no one surpass them in acting upon it, Ali establishes the Imams as the ultimate exemplars of Qur'anic implementation.
